findings.title: "Silence notifications" menu item does nothing in the new list view
findings.body: The list view now passes only `promRule` to `RuleActionsButtons`, so `rule` (the ruler rule) is undefined. `AlertRuleMenu` still shows "Silence notifications" whenever `canSilence` is true, and here that comes from `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities`. The click handler sets `showSilenceDrawer`, but the drawer only renders when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true. With no ruler rule, the drawer never opens and the menu item is a dead button. The new GrafanaGroupLoader test asserts the item is present but never clicks it, so this is not caught. The drawer needs to work from the prom rule (UID/labels), or the item should be hidden when it can't be acted on.

findings.title: Delete and Pause actions silently disappear from the list view
findings.body: `canDelete`/`canPause` can now be true via the prom-rule abilities. Rendering, however, still requires a ruler rule: `canDelete && rulerRule` here, and `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` for Pause at line 123. The list view no longer loads ruler rules, so users with delete/update permission can no longer delete or pause/resume Grafana rules from the list. The new GrafanaGroupLoader test grants AlertingRuleDelete/Update yet asserts exactly 4 menu items, which locks in this regression. Delete and Pause should work from a GrafanaRuleIdentifier/prom rule (e.g. fetch the ruler rule on demand), or the regression should be made explicit.

findings.title: skipToken path grants Duplicate based on Grafana create permission, leaking into data-source rules
findings.body: When `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` gets `skipToken` (rule is undefined), `loading` is false and `isPluginProvided` is false. That makes `duplicateSupported` true, so Duplicate becomes `[true, ctx.hasPermission(AlertingRuleCreate)]`. `AlertRuleMenu` ORs this with the ruler abilities. For any data-source (cloud) rule, which always takes the skipToken path, "Duplicate" is therefore shown whenever the user has the Grafana rule-create permission. This happens even when the ruler-based check says it is unsupported (ruler unavailable/loading) or not allowed (no external write permission). This affects the existing RulesTable and rule viewer, not just the new list. A skipped rule should return NotSupported for every action. RulesTable tests mock the prom hook to `[false,false]` for cloud rules, which hides this.

findings.title: Federated rule groups are no longer treated as immutable
findings.body: `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` previously computed `isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` from the CombinedRule. It now delegates to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, which hardcodes `isFederated = false`. Every consumer of `useAlertRuleAbility`/`useAlertRuleAbilities` loses that guard, including the default (non-V2) RulesTable list and rule details. Edit/Delete/Pause are now offered for Mimir federated rule groups (`source_tenants`). Editing those groups through the Grafana form is not supported and risks rewriting the group without its federation settings. The CombinedRule's group is still available in `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` and should be used to keep the check.

findings.title: Prom-based abilities exclude Grafana recording rules from Export/Pause/Restore
findings.body: The ruler-based hook gates ModifyExport/Pause/Restore/DeletePermanently on `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rule)`, which covers any Grafana-managed rule including recording rules. The new prom-based hook gates them on `prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` instead. In the list view only the prom path is evaluated, so Grafana recording rules lose the "Export" menu entry and the pause ability. The two hooks now disagree for the same rule. Use `prometheusRuleType.grafana.rule(rule)` for these actions to keep parity, and keep `alertingRule` only for Silence.

findings.title: Missing React key for Grafana rule items in filtered list
findings.body: The previous `GrafanaRuleLoader` received `key={key}`. The replacement `<GrafanaRuleListItem ... />` inside `rules.map` has no key, although `key` is destructured on the line above for exactly this purpose and the other branches still pass it. React will emit missing-key warnings and fall back to index-based reconciliation for these stateful items, which hold delete-modal and silence-drawer state.

findings.title: Rule detail link no longer carries returnTo
findings.body: The removed implementation built the link as `createRelativeUrl('/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view', { returnTo: createReturnTo() })`. The new component drops `returnTo`. Navigating from the list (including a filtered search) to a rule's detail page no longer lets the viewer return to the same list state/filters, which is a UX regression unrelated to removing ruler calls.

findings.title: Stale doc comment says group is loaded from Ruler endpoint
findings.body: The JSDoc still says the component "Loads an evaluation group from Prometheus and Ruler endpoints", but this PR removes the ruler query and it now only uses the Prometheus endpoint. The comment in `prometheusGroupsGenerator.ts` ("preload ruler rules", variable `cacheAndRulerPreload`) is similarly stale now that the ruler prefetch was removed.
